issue.title: Statistics test helper leaves Footprint card loading on real data
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1rq.2.1.4.1.3 note #5. In full contention monitor jc6gbkn1bdjd, test_statistics_footprint.py raised ValueError unknown feature cli:bead.list from a card worker. That phase observed nine real card failures before adding a module-only seam in 4a7ce0f330. Current tests/ace/tui/_statistics_pane_ui_helpers.py::patch_center replaces list/code loaders but not footprint_render.fetch_footprint_card; test_statistics_pane_view_navigation.py and test_statistics_view_number_select.py still use fake rows with the real card loader. Add a coherent default card seam to patch_center, allow explicit overrides, and verify navigation and number selection cannot hit the real backend. Visual helpers do not use this seam. Small scope: known missing dependency injection, no production policy change. All-status searches and last-week sweep found no duplicate or causally related active epic.

task_type_fields.impact: Statistics navigation tests perform unintended backend work and can raise worker errors under load.
task_type_fields.repro: Use patch_center with its synthetic Footprint rows, navigate to Footprint and select a row; the unpatched fetch_footprint_card sees fake cli:bead.list. Phase .3 recorded WorkerFailed/ValueError and nine card fetch exceptions; current helper still omits the card seam.

issue.creation_reason: The contention failures phase found fake Statistics rows reaching the real card backend. Its local workaround leaves other callers of the shared helper exposed.
